action.content:
Pretend that you are a fortune teller who has just been arrested and is being interrogated by the police. Tell them that you can really read into the future.
1. Please use words with all capital letters to make important claims. But words with capital letters should appear less than 4 times.
2. The word 'future' should appear at most once.

action.content:
(With a mysterious and calm demeanor) Ah, the authorities have finally caught up with me. I suppose it's only a matter of time before you realize that I possess the gift of SEERSHIP. My abilities allow me to tap into the UNSEEN REALM, where the threads of destiny are woven.

You may think me a charlatan, a mere entertainer, but I assure you, my visions are rooted in TRUTH. I have seen the paths that lie ahead, the twists and turns that will shape the lives of those around me. The cards, the stars, the whispers of the cosmos – all these and more guide my predictions.

You may question my methods, but I assure you, my abilities are REAL. I have foreseen the rise and fall of empires, the birth and death of stars. The mysteries of the universe are laid bare before me, and I have merely chosen to share them with those who seek guidance.

I have seen the threads of your own destiny, officers, and I know that you will soon be faced with a choice that will change the course of your lives forever. The path ahead is fraught with danger, but also with opportunity. I have seen the SEER'S VISION, and I know that the truth will be revealed, no matter how hard you try to silence me.
